```{r}
#| label: student-feedback-survey
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

# Locate the QMD directory
chapter_dir <- dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))

# Load GCET helper functions
source(file.path(chapter_dir, "_data_helpers.R"))

# Feedback folder alongside the QMD
root <- file.path(chapter_dir, "24_student_feedback_survey")

# File-to-heading mapping
sections <- c(
  "1.png" = "Student Feedback",
  "2.png" = "Course Exit Survey"
)

for (file_name in names(sections)) {

  cat("## ", sections[[file_name]], "\n\n", sep = "")

  file <- file.path(root, file_name)

  if (file.exists(file)) {

    # Use a path relative to the QMD directory (an absolute path breaks
    # the PDF build, as Quarto prefixes it with the chapter folder).
    path <- file.path("24_student_feedback_survey", file_name)

    cat(
      "![](<", path, ">){width=95%}\n\n",
      sep = ""
    )

  } else {

    cat("*Survey image not available.*\n\n")
  }
}
```


```{r}
#| label: activity-evidence-sheet
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

library(xml2)
library(knitr)

# ============================================================
# 1. PROJECT CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

chapter_dir <- dirname(
  normalizePath(
    knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE),
    winslash = "/",
    mustWork = TRUE
  )
)

helper_candidates <- c(
  file.path(chapter_dir, "_data_helpers.R"),
  file.path(chapter_dir, "..", "_data_helpers.R")
)

helper_file <- helper_candidates[file.exists(helper_candidates)]

if (!length(helper_file)) {
  stop("Cannot locate _data_helpers.R")
}

source(helper_file[[1]])

evidence_root <- normalizePath(
  file.path(chapter_dir, "20_innovative_tl_practices"),
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)

workbook <- normalizePath(
  get_workbook_path(),
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)

# Lesson Plan columns
lecture_col  <- 1L
topic_col    <- 4L
activity_col <- 6L
date_col     <- 8L

sheet_name <- cf_sheet("lesson_plan")
range_name <- cf_range("lesson_plan")

# ============================================================
# 2. READ LESSON PLAN
# ============================================================

lesson <- readxl::read_excel(
  workbook,
  sheet = sheet_name,
  range = range_name,
  col_names = FALSE,
  .name_repair = "minimal"
)

if (ncol(lesson) < 8L) {
  stop("Lesson Plan range must contain columns A through H.")
}

range_start <- strsplit(
  range_name, ":", fixed = TRUE
)[[1]][1]

start_row <- as.integer(
  gsub("[^0-9]", "", range_start)
)

if (is.na(start_row)) {
  stop("Cannot determine starting Excel row.")
}

# ============================================================
# 3. READ XLSM XML
# ============================================================

tmp <- tempfile("gcet-lesson-")
dir.create(tmp)

utils::unzip(workbook, exdir = tmp)

main_ns <- c(
  x = paste0(
    "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/",
    "spreadsheetml/2006/main"
  )
)

office_rel_ns <- c(
  r = paste0(
    "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/",
    "officeDocument/2006/relationships"
  )
)

workbook_xml <- xml2::read_xml(
  file.path(tmp, "xl/workbook.xml")
)

workbook_rels <- xml2::read_xml(
  file.path(tmp, "xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels")
)

# ============================================================
# 4. IDENTIFY LESSON PLAN WORKSHEET
# ============================================================

sheet_nodes <- xml2::xml_find_all(
  workbook_xml,
  ".//x:sheet",
  ns = main_ns
)

sheet_names <- xml2::xml_attr(sheet_nodes, "name")

sheet_index <- which(
  !is.na(sheet_names) &
    sheet_names == sheet_name
)

if (length(sheet_index) != 1L) {
  stop("Lesson Plan worksheet not found: ", sheet_name)
}

sheet_node <- sheet_nodes[[sheet_index]]

# Namespace-independent extraction of r:id
relationship_id <- xml2::xml_attr(
  sheet_node,
  "r:id",
  ns = office_rel_ns
)

if (
  length(relationship_id) != 1L ||
  is.na(relationship_id) ||
  !nzchar(relationship_id)
) {

  attrs <- xml2::xml_attrs(sheet_node)

  id_positions <- which(
    names(attrs) == "r:id" |
      grepl("(^|:)id$", names(attrs))
  )

  if (length(id_positions)) {
    relationship_id <- unname(
      attrs[[id_positions[[1]]]]
    )
  }
}

if (
  length(relationship_id) != 1L ||
  is.na(relationship_id) ||
  !nzchar(relationship_id)
) {
  stop("Could not determine the Lesson Plan relationship ID.")
}

# ============================================================
# 5. RESOLVE WORKSHEET XML PATH
# ============================================================

rel_nodes <- xml2::xml_find_all(
  workbook_rels,
  ".//*[local-name()='Relationship']"
)

rel_ids <- xml2::xml_attr(rel_nodes, "Id")

rel_index <- which(
  !is.na(rel_ids) &
    rel_ids == relationship_id
)

if (length(rel_index) != 1L) {
  stop("Worksheet relationship not found: ", relationship_id)
}

sheet_target <- xml2::xml_attr(
  rel_nodes[[rel_index]],
  "Target"
)

if (
  length(sheet_target) != 1L ||
  is.na(sheet_target) ||
  !nzchar(sheet_target)
) {
  stop("Worksheet XML target is missing.")
}

sheet_target <- gsub("\\\\", "/", sheet_target)

sheet_path <- if (startsWith(sheet_target, "/")) {
  file.path(tmp, sub("^/", "", sheet_target))
} else {
  file.path(tmp, "xl", sheet_target)
}

sheet_path <- normalizePath(
  sheet_path,
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)

sheet_xml <- xml2::read_xml(sheet_path)

# ============================================================
# 6. EXTRACT EXCEL HYPERLINKS FROM COLUMN F
# ============================================================

sheet_rels_path <- file.path(
  dirname(sheet_path),
  "_rels",
  paste0(basename(sheet_path), ".rels")
)

links <- data.frame(
  cell = character(),
  target = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

hyperlink_nodes <- xml2::xml_find_all(
  sheet_xml,
  ".//x:hyperlink",
  ns = main_ns
)

if (
  file.exists(sheet_rels_path) &&
  length(hyperlink_nodes) > 0L
) {

  sheet_rels <- xml2::read_xml(sheet_rels_path)

  relationship_nodes <- xml2::xml_find_all(
    sheet_rels,
    ".//*[local-name()='Relationship']"
  )

  relationship_ids <- xml2::xml_attr(
    relationship_nodes,
    "Id"
  )

  for (node in hyperlink_nodes) {

    cell <- xml2::xml_attr(node, "ref")

    if (
      length(cell) != 1L ||
      is.na(cell) ||
      !grepl("^F[0-9]+$", cell)
    ) next

    link_id <- xml2::xml_attr(
      node,
      "r:id",
      ns = office_rel_ns
    )

    if (
      length(link_id) != 1L ||
      is.na(link_id) ||
      !nzchar(link_id)
    ) next

    match_index <- which(
      !is.na(relationship_ids) &
        relationship_ids == link_id
    )

    if (length(match_index) != 1L) next

    target <- xml2::xml_attr(
      relationship_nodes[[match_index]],
      "Target"
    )

    if (
      length(target) != 1L ||
      is.na(target) ||
      !nzchar(target)
    ) next

    links <- rbind(
      links,
      data.frame(
        cell = cell,
        target = target,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }
}

# ============================================================
# 7. MATCH EXISTING LOCAL EVIDENCE
# ============================================================

get_evidence_files <- function(target) {

  if (
    length(target) != 1L ||
    is.na(target) ||
    !nzchar(target)
  ) {
    return(character())
  }

  if (grepl("^(https?|mailto):", target, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(character())
  }

  target <- utils::URLdecode(target)
  target <- sub("^file:///?", "", target, ignore.case = TRUE)
  target <- gsub("\\\\", "/", target)

  candidates <- unique(c(
    target,
    file.path(chapter_dir, target),
    file.path(dirname(workbook), target),
    file.path(evidence_root, target),
    file.path(dirname(chapter_dir), target)
  ))

  for (candidate in candidates) {

    if (!file.exists(candidate) && !dir.exists(candidate)) {
      next
    }

    resolved <- normalizePath(
      candidate,
      winslash = "/",
      mustWork = TRUE
    )

    inside <- identical(resolved, evidence_root) ||
      startsWith(resolved, paste0(evidence_root, "/"))

    if (!inside) next

    files <- if (dir.exists(resolved)) {
      list.files(
        resolved,
        recursive = TRUE,
        full.names = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      resolved
    }

    files <- files[
      file.exists(files) &
        !dir.exists(files)
    ]

    files <- files[
      grepl(
        "\\.(png|jpg|jpeg|pdf)$",
        files,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      )
    ]

    if (length(files)) {
      return(sort(unique(files)))
    }
  }

  character()
}

# ============================================================
# 8. BUILD ACTIVITY & EVIDENCE RECORDS
# ============================================================

get_value <- function(i, column) {

  value <- lesson[[column]][i]

  if (length(value) == 0L || is.na(value)) {
    return("")
  }

  as.character(value)
}

records <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(lesson))) {

  excel_row <- start_row + i - 1L
  cell_ref <- paste0("F", excel_row)

  hit <- links[
    links$cell == cell_ref,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (!nrow(hit)) next

  evidence_files <- get_evidence_files(
    hit$target[[1]]
  )

  if (!length(evidence_files)) next

  activity <- get_value(i, activity_col)

  if (!nzchar(trimws(activity))) next

  records[[length(records) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
    Date = get_value(i, date_col),
    `Lecture No.` = get_value(i, lecture_col),
    Topic = get_value(i, topic_col),
    `Activity Conducted` = activity,
    `Evidence Maintained` = "",
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 9. RENDER TABLE: PDF (9 PT) + DOCX (FLEXTABLE, 9 PT)
# ============================================================

cat("## Activity & Evidence Sheet\n\n")

if (!length(records)) {

  cat("*No matching Activity & Evidence records found.*\n\n")

} else {

  result <- unique(do.call(rbind, records))

  result[] <- lapply(result, function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x[is.na(x) | !nzchar(trimws(x))] <- "—"
    x
  })
  result[["Evidence Maintained"]] <- ""
  names(result) <- c(
    "Date",
    "Lecture No.",
    "Topic",
    "Activity Conducted",
    "Evidence Maintained"
  )

  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # PDF: 9 pt longtable with fixed column widths
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    latex_table <- knitr::kable(
      result,
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      longtable = TRUE,
      row.names = FALSE,
      escape = TRUE,
      linesep = "",
      align = c(
        "p{1.8cm}",
        "p{1.3cm}",
        "p{3.0cm}",
        "p{3.0cm}",
        "p{4.5cm}"
      )
    )

    cat("\\begingroup\n")
    cat("\\fontsize{9}{11}\\selectfont\n")
    cat("\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{3pt}\n")
    cat("\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.05}\n")

    cat(as.character(latex_table), "\n")

    cat("\\endgroup\n\n")

  } else if (knitr::pandoc_to("docx")) {

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # DOCX: flextable, 9 pt
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    ft <- flextable::flextable(result)

    ft <- flextable::font(
      ft,
      fontname = "Times New Roman",
      part = "all"
    )

    ft <- flextable::fontsize(
      ft,
      size = 9,
      part = "all"
    )

    ft <- flextable::bold(
      ft,
      part = "header"
    )

    ft <- flextable::align(
      ft,
      j = 2,
      align = "center",
      part = "all"
    )

    ft <- flextable::valign(
      ft,
      valign = "top",
      part = "all"
    )

    ft <- flextable::padding(
      ft,
      padding = 3,
      part = "all"
    )

    ft <- flextable::set_table_properties(
      ft,
      layout = "fixed",
      width = 1
    )

    ft <- flextable::width(
      ft,
      j = 1:5,
      width = c(
        0.85,
        0.65,
        1.35,
        1.35,
        2.20
      )
    )

    # Repeat header row on subsequent Word pages
    ft <- flextable::set_table_properties(
      ft,
      opts_word = list(
        repeat_headers = TRUE
      )
    )

    # Emit flextable in Quarto/knitr
    cat(
      as.character(knitr::knit_print(ft)),
      sep = "\n"
    )

    cat("\n\n")

  } else {

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Other output formats
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    cat(
      knitr::kable(
        result,
        format = "pipe",
        row.names = FALSE
      ),
      sep = "\n"
    )

    cat("\n\n")
  }
}

# ============================================================
# 10. CLEAN UP
# ============================================================

unlink(tmp, recursive = TRUE)
```
